messages.subject: shiny server and how to know the process.
parts: Hello everyone I'm going to paint in a client a matrix with almost 3000X3000 data and this operation takes a few minutes, so I want to know how much time the server takes to finish the operation and show in the client a message to wait, the problema is that I don't know how to get a time to the server for the client, may be, do you know how to make this ? thank you for all, and I hope to can help me.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny server and how to know the process.
parts: There is no general solution to this problem (predict how long the server will be busy) but it would be possible to add calls within your own code to calculate how many units of data you have processed, how many are left, how much time has elapsed, estimate how much time is remaining, etc. However, Shiny currently does not have a way to send custom progress messages while it is busy executing; instead it will mark each output component as "in progress" and then unmark them all simultaneously when execution completes. We hope to add a way to do custom progress in the future though.
